summary: Graphic Packaging Holding Co. filed a routine Form 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing under Item 8.01 that representatives will meet with investors and expect to reference the Fall 2026 Corporate Governance and Stewardship presentation furnished as Exhibit 99.1. The filing contains no transaction terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics; it is a routine investor-communication current report, not a special situation. The only related content is forward-looking language and non-GAAP reconciliations. No deal terms were stated. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; governance and capital-spending commentary may move shares modestly.
